archetype: LUXURY & SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST (Dark Ink + Molten Gold)

principles: Fusion over Imitation: High-fashion editorial spacing paired with high-performance Swiss grid rhythm.
Molten Gold Focus: Pure #000000 / #0B0B0E dark obsidian canvas with surgical molten gold (#EAB308 / #D4AF37) accents for high-value CTAs and tier highlights.
Asymmetrical Tension: Left-aligned editorial hierarchy, numbered manifesto chapters (01 // CORE, 02 // SERVICES, 03 // PRICING), line-masked text reveals.
Tactile Glass & Metal: 1px subtle gold-tinted borders (rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.15)), backdrop-blur-xl dark cards, tracing glowing borders on hover.
Zero Visual Slop: Banned default Inter/Roboto for headings. Uses Outfit / Cormorant Garamond for display and JetBrains Mono for technical metadata.
